BARBARIAN HIGHLANDS
It is said that when the world was very young the tribes of the Northern Steppes were given a sacred charge. Somewhere deep within the great mountain, Arreat, lies a source of great power, crucial to the well being of all humanity. The tribes act as guardians of this artifact, and through this sacred duty, have shaped their way of life in observance of this power.

Guest Monsters
In Nightmare and Hell Difficulty, Act V becomes inhabited with the stragglers of previous demon armies which you have fought in the past. The types of enemies that appear are random. They are also more powerful than in previous Acts. By the inclusion of these "guest monsters" Act V in Nightmare and Hell truly becomes an amalgam of all of the Acts in the game, and the ultimate challenge to Diablo II players.
